title: Add an index to speed up reads
why_it_matters: Slow queries on big tables usually need one.
explanation: An index is like a book's index: the database jumps straight to matching rows instead of scanning the table. Index columns you filter or sort by often, like foreign keys. Too many indexes slow down writes, so don't add them blindly.
try_it: Think of two columns in your app that you filter by often.
